name: Bridged VMPX (Ethereum) - unofficial
description: Representation of VMPX (Ethereum, 0xb48Eb8368c9C6e9b0734de1Ef4ceB9f484B80b9C) locked in a Hyperlane collateral router. Issued by a private bridge operator, NOT by the VMPX issuer. Redeemable 1:1 by bridging back to Ethereum. Security: operator-run validator multisig.
